authority_basis.summary: Record the completed family transport audit for the four-site node defect.

operations.title: The four-site node defect is constant until existing Gram support
operations.body: The eight sign nodes are constant sections Delta=0 as G varies. On det(G) nonzero their Hessians have rank three and the unique chi_234 defect line is constant. At a generic rank-two Gram point adj(G) has rank one and the branch quadratic becomes a square, so degeneration occurs only on existing Gram support.

operations.title: Exact node-family Hessian-rank audit
operations.body: The checker verifies rank adj(G)=3 on a nonsingular Gram witness and rank adj(G)=1 on a rank-two witness, while preserving the constant sign sections and chi_111 defect character.

operations.title: Benincasa reports constant node defect up to Gram support
operations.body: Entry 1174: the eight nodes are persistent labelled sections Delta=0, so on detG!=0 the rank-seven lattice and its total-parity defect line are constant; generic external motion does not supply a smoothing or PL permutation. The first failure is detG=0, where adjG has rank one and the branch quadratic becomes a square. This is existing Gram support; the next typed test is its transverse Kato/Gysin nearby-cycle comparison.
